title: Micronauts #41 49 Lot Marvel Comics 1982-1983 Doctor Doom Gil Kane Bronze Age
conditionDescription: Both covers clean and bright with no creases or tears; spines and staples intact. Light handling wear. See photos.
descriptionText:
The Micronauts (Marvel Comics, 1979 series) - 2 issues. 75c cover price each.

You get:
- #41 (May 1982) - "Doom!" - Doctor Doom cover by Gil Kane. Back cover: Gabriel Lone Ranger "Free Western Town" toy ad.
- #49 (Jan 1983) - "They Came From Inner Space". Back cover: full-color Micronauts art pin-up.

See photos for condition. Ships bagged together in a protective mailer.
